message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (for a standard 108‑card deck)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play a set number of rounds). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in your hand and then scoring the value of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Card Types** | • **Number cards** (0–9) – match by color or number.
• **Action cards** – “Skip”, “Reverse”, “Draw Two” (match by color only).
• **Wild cards** – “Wild” (any color), “Wild Draw Four” (any color + force next player to draw four). | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Play** – If you have a card that matches the top card on the discard pile by color, number, or symbol, you may play it. If you play a Wild or Wild Draw Four, you must declare the new color.
2. **Draw** – If you cannot play, draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played immediately, you may do so; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Actions** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the direction of play (in a two‑player game, acts like Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can be challenged if the player who drew had a playable card.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, they shout “UNO!” if they have one card left. If they forget, the next player can call them out and force them to draw two cards. The round ends when a player has no cards left. | | **Scoring** | • Number cards: face value.
• Draw Two, Reverse, Skip: 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
Points are tallied from the cards remaining in opponents’ hands. | | **Game End** | First player to reach 500 points wins. Alternatively, play a predetermined number of rounds and tally total points. | **Optional House Rules** - *Stacking*: Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing. - *No Challenge*: Some groups skip the challenge rule for Wild Draw Four. - *Custom Decks*: Use themed decks or add extra wild cards. That’s the core of Uno! Feel free to tweak house rules to suit your group.
